observations: A large black rounded shape with two lobed upper sections and small antennae floats left of center against a flat bright blue field; yellow X-marks serve as eyes and a jagged yellow line forms a mouth.
Irregular zigzag and wavy lines radiate outward from the central figure in all directions across the blue ground, varying in length and amplitude.
A smaller black flower-shaped figure stands at lower right, bearing yellow spiral eyes and a wavy yellow mouth, with shorter radiating lines around it; a solid black strip runs along the bottom edge.
reading: Two black figures face each other across open blue space, the larger hovering, the smaller rooted at the bottom edge. Both carry matching yellow eye-and-mouth marks, so the pairing reads less as threat and more as a meeting of similar expressions. The radiating lines around each figure suggest agitation or charge. The mood feels tense but faintly comic, held in balance by the flat, even blue.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work stands apart for its near-empty ground and two-figure staging. Title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #105 and nnxyz nnotb #107 are dense, multi-color compositions; the spare blue field and black silhouettes here form a strong contrast within the same owned sequence.

connections.reason: Both works use the same flat bright blue ground with a dominant black figure placed against it, making the high-contrast silhouette the primary structural device in each.

lookingQuestion: Do the radiating lines around the two figures behave the same way, or does their length, density, or shape differ between the larger and smaller form?
